name: moonshotai/kimi-k2.5
description: Kimi K2.5 is Moonshot AI's open-source native multimodal agentic model, built by continuing pretraining of Kimi K2 on about 15 trillion mixed visual and text tokens. It is a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 32B active parameters and a 256K-token context, offering instant and thinking modes. Moonshot highlights coding from visual specifications such as UI designs and an agent swarm mode that splits complex tasks across parallel sub-agents; Kimi K2.6 later succeeded it.
